timing_basis.reason: No host connection or returned GPU logs. Limits are not runtime predictions.

cost_model.per_arm_round: load_or_switch + generate(prefill, actual_tokens) + reference_forwards + training + official_scoring + diagnostics + checkpoint_save
cost_model.comparison_bundle: sum distinct compatible arm-round costs + shared base evaluation + all failed/tuning costs + statistical replay/E04/export
cost_model.admission: Start a whole eligible comparison bundle only if its conservative measured estimate plus 15-minute closeout fits the original remaining hard budget. Otherwise retain the bundle pending; do not drop controls.
cost_model.memory: Use target-host measured free/total VRAM, actual dtype/rank/sequence shape and required headroom. Do not infer fit from tiny CPU tests.
cost_model.cost_matched: Equal-data/updates and equal-training-wall-clock are separate panels; the latter needs its own frozen implementation and cannot be inferred from the former.

tasks.rule: Retain all per-method controls and mandatory qualified published comparisons; admission requires candidate design_verified and scientific prerequisites.
Use ranked complete bundles; methods need not be run serially by candidate when compatible controls are shared, but only one GPU workload at once.
No automatic new eight-hour grant; no reuse of inspected confirmation to tune.
Scope claims to separately qualified groups. New protocol/data/code cannot resume an old run identity.
One additional scale in the same family, not proof of cross-family generalization. No weights downloaded or fit measured.

carryover: Stable attempt/protocol identities; unchanged complete comparisons only within the original cumulative authorization; all incomplete/failed outputs preserved.
stop: Hard original deadline, invalid source/score identity, exhausted attempt/resource ceiling, or no qualified task. These produce pending/inconclusive, not automatic scientific KILL.
